subject: website
name: Afolabi Aiyeloja
summary: The portfolio of Afolabi Aiyeloja. Its source is public (MIT). It runs no third-party code and loads only its own files, which is Level 3. It is not Level 4: the bundle includes Sentry and Vercel Analytics code that can send requests, and its contact form posts to a server.

connections.name: Contact form server
connections.note: The contact form sends the message to a backend when the user submits it.

connections.name: Sentry and Vercel Analytics (bundled)
connections.note: Reporting code in the site's own files; no request was seen when the page opened.
